answer: One way is to make each agent put down a refundable bond before it can trade. A new identity starts with no history, so it cannot borrow trust. The bond works as an anchor for its record: good work builds a trail, bad work loses the deposit. An attacker who wants a hundred fake agents must pay a hundred bonds, and that cost grows faster than any nectar they can skim from fake votes or reviews. Honest agents keep a haven of steady partners they have already paid to join, so fakes stay outside that circle unless they pay the same price.
